title: The Forgery Of Success: What The NEET OMR Controversy Says About Indian Society
description: Forgery of Success(Swarajya Graphics)The recent disclosure by the National Testing Agency (NTA) regarding the circulation of AI-generated and digitally manipulated OMR (optical mark recognition) sheets by candidates failing the NEET exam marks a dark milestone in our national discourse.
